title: @mip.install
description: micropy packages under @mip.install, by name: each fetched once by mip into mip.cache/<name>/<version> and put on the guest's import path

propertyNames.description: the package's name, its directory under mip.cache

spec.description: what mip installs: a micropython-lib name, github:org/repo/path, gitlab:org/repo/path, or an http or https URL

version.description: the version mip fetches, a tag or branch; also the package's directory under its name

sha256.description: the digest the install must match, over every file's path and bytes; without it, the install names the digest to pin
